content.string: The meeting is called to order at 12:01 PM.
That is BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

2.title: Election of Vice Chair for the term ending November 30, 2024

motion_texts.string: That Councillor S. Stevenson BE APPOINTED as Vice Chair for the term ending November 30, 2024.

1.title: Briefing Note From Internal Audit - MNP

motion_texts.string: That the communication from MNP, with respect to the briefing note from the internal auditor, BE RECEIVED.

2.title: Internal Audit Follow Up Activities Dashboard - MNP

motion_texts.string: That the communication from MNP, with respect to the internal audit follow up activities update dashboard, BE RECEIVED.

3.title: Downtown Closed Circuit Television Program - KPMG

motion_texts.string: That the KPMG Report on Specified Auditing Procedures for the London Downtown Closed Circuit Television Program, for the year ending December 31, 2023, BE RECEIVED.
That the KPMG LLP Audit Planning Report, for the year ending December 31, 2023, BE APPROVED.

That the Audit Committee convenes In Closed Session to consider the following: 



6.1  Security of Property



A matter pertaining to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.

post_motion_texts.string: That the Audit Committee convenes In Closed Session from12:27 PM to 12:40 PM.
